name: seeit-backend
description: Express + PostgreSQL API for the SeeIt streaming site

scripts.db:setup: node db/init.js && node db/seed.js && node db/run-sql.js db/extra-titles.sql && node db/run-sql.js db/migrate-sections.sql && node db/run-sql.js db/new-sections.sql && node db/run-sql.js db/more-games.sql && npm run db:images
scripts.db:upgrade: node db/run-sql.js db/migrate-sections.sql && node db/run-sql.js db/new-sections.sql
scripts.db:images: node db/run-sql.js db/new-images.sql && node db/run-sql.js db/sync-hero-images.sql
